audit.reasoning: (1) Quote check: the deciding sentence is present verbatim at p.565 in the held Google Books snippet JSON of The Munda Languages, and the complete passage (including the 'every subsequent even numbered syllable gets secondary stress' continuation used for the secondary-stress rule and the iambic/extrametrical analysis with parses) is held in the authors' 2007 preprint of the same chapter (our earlier reading, draft pp.1354-1355, sec. 1.5 = published 2.5). (2) Deciding source: a 2008 grammar sketch in the standard family volume by the fieldworkers themselves; impressionistic, Plains Remo only, but it is the most recent and only explicit description of Remo stress.
